title: Airplane Napa Valley Flight Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Flight can be recorded for an additional fee
If bringing an infant please bring your own car seat
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Enjoy a safe and breathtaking 1.5-hour aerial tour over the Napa Valley in a modern high wing Cessna or a low wing Piper, both of which are known to optimize viewing and comfort. Fly in the company of an experienced FAA certified Pilot and guide who will help you discover the region and ensure an amazing experience.

Fly from Hayward, over downtown Oakland, El Cerrito, and San Pablo Bay. See the beauty of each area on the way towards the Napa Valley, thirty miles long and five miles wide. Discover more than 500 wineries throughout a collection of six quaint towns.

View Napa, Yountville, Oakville, Rutherford, St. Helena, and Calistoga from the sky. Each has its own personality and places to discover. From Napa’s urban wine trail to Yountville’s renowned fine dining, to Calistoga’s detoxifying hot springs, there’s something for every kind of traveler, whether you’re an oenophile, foodie, adventurist, or self-care aficionado.
